answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the timber graph. Re-attestations are stored in terrace and plume lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 763 impostors cost 1037 times the honest price and take 8 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
